about.description: Gate offers a stablecoin backed by real-world assets and Treasury securities, combining yield generation with price stability. It enables institutional-grade stable settlement with underlying RWA collateral.
about.registryInfo: No operating entity published. Gate's user agreement, privacy policy and law-enforcement pages define the counterparty only as Gate and its affiliates, naming no company, jurisdiction or registration number. Gate's Dubai VARA licence expressly excludes virtual asset derivatives trading.
